# Kelomaja – holiday cabins at Sallatunturi, Salla, Finnish Lapland

Owner: Arvo Puhakka, +358 50 539 4738, arvo.puhakka@kelomaja.fi. Pets welcome in both cabins.

## Kelomaja
Revontie 8 B, 98900 Salla. Kelo-log semi-detached cabin, 54 m², 2 bedrooms + loft, sleeps 6.
Sauna with a window to the fell, heat-storing fireplace (firewood included), Wi-Fi 200 Mbit/s, 42" smart TV.
Ski track 40 m, ski resort 100 m, slopes 300 m. From €90 a night, €490 a week. Book: https://www.nettimokki.com/salla/kelomaja/52377/

## Kuusisto
Tunturitie 10 A, 98900 Salla. Fully renovated semi-detached cabin, 54 m², 1 bedroom + loft + sofa bed, sleeps 4 + 2.
Private sauna, fireplace, Wi-Fi 200 Mbit/s. Ski track 70 m, spa 400 m, slopes 500 m. From €90 a night, €480 a week.
Book: https://www.nettimokki.com/salla/kuusisto/51299/

## Sallatunturi
Salla ski resort: 15 slopes, 7 lifts, longest run 1,300 m. 160 km of ski tracks. Salla National Park and Ruuhitunturi nearby.
Pages: /sallatunturi (things to do) and one page per nearby place.
